title: bug: providerDescriptor.contract.test.ts fails 4/23 since be889d73 (WT-05) moved the codex config writer out of the test's anchored codex branches
description:
Repro: in a git-archive snapshot of be889d73, run `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm ci && npx vitest run src/providers/providerDescriptor.contract.test.ts`. Result: 4 failed | 19 passed. The anchored site is 122 lines where the test expects >200, and 22 shared, 43 emitter and 17 side-specific literals read "absent". The full daemon suite fails only this file (4 failed | 6250 passed | 20 skipped). With scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1} taken from be889d73^ the file passes 23/23.
Cause: WT-05 moved the codex config writer into write_codex_config() (moe-agent.sh:973) and Write-MoeCodexConfig (moe-agent.ps1:997). Both now sit outside BRANCH_ANCHORS (providerDescriptor.contract.test.ts:60-68), and the anchored codex site shrank from 372 to 200 lines (sh) and from 374 to 228 lines (ps1). Fix: anchor those writers and re-point codexDescriptor's emitter evidence at the worktree-aware literals. Never weaken an assertion. CI's daemon test:coverage gate is red until this lands. Found by CQ-R13 (task-f4811a72) step-4 verification.

Preserve the entire command invocation for each mode, not just '-C' or a path token; preserve every table/key, every fact, and every distinct emitter occurrence. On the explored baseline the concrete changes are:
- BASH_LAUNCH_INTERACTIVE and BASH_LAUNCH_EXEC: replace -C "$PROJECT" with -C "${CLI_ROOT:-$PROJECT}".
- PS_LAUNCH_INTERACTIVE and PS_LAUNCH_EXEC: replace -C "$projectPath" with -C "$script:cliRoot"; retain Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand and all argument splats.
- BASH_SEAT_ARG_WORKER_ID: read "${CLI_ROOT:-$PROJECT}/.codex/config.toml", not "$PROJECT/.codex/config.toml".

For example, the Bash override must remain the full literal:
```ts

```
Do not globally replace PROJECT/projectPath: the MCP daemon control-project env intentionally still uses the control root, while the configuration destination and CLI -C use the worktree root. Preserve those control-root pins. The helper parameter names are case-sensitive literal evidence ($root vs $Root). If the prerequisite changed an invocation, use its actual full landed invocation with equivalent or stronger evidence, never delete an evidence entry to make it pass. Do not modify either launcher, providerDescriptor.ts, event-fact classification, or unrelated descriptor prose.
